task.description:
Design and write SCH-04 test coverage aligned with the implemented backend changes.

Requirements:
- Create or update the SCH-04 test specification under tests/specs/.
- Review the new integration tests added for SCH-04 and add any missing focused coverage needed to trace to all SCH-04 acceptance criteria.
- Ensure the test plan covers: escalation timer creation on HUMAN_TASK activation, ESCALATION event append when task remains PENDING, optional reassignment in the same transaction, and cancellation on task completion before firing.
- Keep tests aligned to existing scheduler/integration test structure.

Validation requirement:
- zig build test exits 0 after your test changes.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/SCH-04.md exists and traces all SCH-04 acceptance criteria
Test sources cover timer creation, escalation firing, reassignment, and completion cancellation behaviors

result.summary: Created SCH-04 test specification and completed focused scheduler integration coverage traceability for escalation timer creation, escalation firing, reassignment, cancellation, and PD-05 duration validation ownership.
